content.rendered:
Bring your friends and family, test your luck, and see if you can shout “Bingo!” first! One FREE Bingo board for every participant, with additional boards (optional) available for .50¢ each. Hot dogs, snacks, candy and water will be available for purchase.

**This is not a drop off event, all students need to be accompanied by an adult**
